subject: Request: Senior approval for strategic Hosted API discount for HelixBio
thread_text:
From: Emma Li <emma.li@helixbio.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Cc: Daniel Cho <daniel@helixbio.com>; Finance - HelixBio <ap@helixbio.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Aug 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted API commercial request & SOW follow-up

Marcus —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. The team is excited to move forward but I need to be upfront: leadership wants a commercial structure that reflects our multi-year strategic evaluation of Redwood for inference.

Quick ask: Can Redwood provide a 30% off list hosted-API usage rate for the first 12 months in exchange for a 24-month minimum commitment at the volumes in the attached model? This would make the economics work for us against our incumbent.

Attached is an updated go-to-market model (HelixBio_GoToMarket_Modeling.xlsx) and a redline SOW (Signed_SOW_Draft_v3.docx) with the proposed milestone payment schedule.

If you can route this to the right person for senior signoff, we can aim to execute by end of month.

—Emma
Emma Li
Head of Platform Partnerships
HelixBio

----
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Emma Li <emma.li@helixbio.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Aug 2029 09:43:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API commercial request & SOW follow-up

Emma — appreciate the transparency and the materials. HelixBio is a strategic target for our life-sciences vertical and the marketplace integration they propose adds defensibility for both sides.

High-level economics from our side (proposed):
- Baseline list rate: $0.012/token (example blended list)
- Helix ask: 30% off = effective $0.0084/token for first 12 months
- Expected committed monthly spend (month 1-6): ~$120k/mo; month 7-24 ramp to ~$320k/mo (see attached model)
- Estimated gross margin impact to Redwood in year 1 with 30% concession: ~9 percentage points vs standard pricing, offset partially by marketplace uplift and reference status.

Ask: I need senior approval for anything >20% off list on Hosted API. Karthik and Ben — can you weigh in on whether a 30% concession (with contractual lock-in + marketplace promotion + joint PR) is acceptable and if we can tie any performance or volume triggers to step-downs?

I’ve attached the redline SOW and a brief math summary. If this needs to go to Revenue Ops or Legal for special T&Cs, please flag.

Thanks,
Marcus
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

----
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Aug 2029 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API commercial request & SOW follow-up

Looping in details from deal desk and finance review. Key points:
- A straight 30% off list for 12 months is outside current concession authority. Anything >20% requires SR (Senior Revenue) approval.
- Conditions to make this acceptable from a POE (proof of economics) perspective:
  * 24-month minimum term with annualized committed spend >= $2.4M (Helix model shows ~3.6M ARR by month 12 ramp).
  * Quarterly business reviews and a joint marketing commitment (co-authored case study within 9 months).
  * Usage floors and step-up pricing if monthly committed thresholds are missed (step-up to 20% off if floor missed; reversion to list if missed twice).
  * Legal to approve limited warranty language — no open-ended indemnities.

If SR grants 30% for year one with the above guardrails, the strategic upside could justify the margin delta. Ben — can you run final margin sensitivity and confirm runway to positive unit contribution if required?

Karthik
Head of Deal Desk
Redwood Inference

----
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Aug 2029 08:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API commercial request & SOW follow-up

Quick calc: with the expected mix and prefix cache gains, a 30% list concession for the first 12 months yields an expected blended unit margin of ~22% in year 1 (down from ~31% at list). Beyond year 1, economics recover assuming Helix hits the ramp curve in the model. The biggest risk is if they under-deliver vs committed monthly floors — that’s why the step-up is essential.

I recommend SR approval only if we: 1) codify the usage floors, 2) include marketplace/PR commitments, and 3) add a review/fallback at 12 months.

Ben
Director, Revenue Strategy
Redwood Inference

----
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Aug 2029 15:47:00 -0700
Subject: SR approval request: HelixBio hosted-API 30% concession (HLX-2029-058)

Team —

Putting this up for SR approval. Summary and recommended guardrails below for the SR packet and the exec thread: 

Summary:
- Account: HelixBio (life sciences vertical)
- Deal ID: HLX-2029-058
- Ask: Approve 30% off list hosted-API usage for months 0–11
- Committed term: 24 months
- Expected committed spend: ~$2.9M first 12 months (model attached)
- Strategic upside: marketplace integration, enterprise reference, embedded marketplace listing, potential multi-account expansion across Helix divisions

Recommended guardrails (mandatory if SR approves):
1) 24-month minimum term documented in SOW
2) Minimum monthly usage floors (month-by-month thresholds in attached model); if floor missed, pricing step-up to 20% off for remainder of term; two consecutive misses -> reversion to list pricing
3) Joint case study + marketplace onboarding milestone (to be completed by month 9)
4) Legal to approve limited liability clauses; no custom data residency concessions beyond standard Private options
5) Finance to require an escrowed first invoice or bank guarantee for month 1–3 if payments slow during procurement review

Attachments included for SR packet: HelixBio_GoToMarket_Modeling.xlsx (volume ramp sheet), Signed_SOW_Draft_v3.docx (commercial redline), and a 1-page margin summary.

Please reply all with SR decision. If approved, I will initiate DocuSign route and coordinate legal to finalize the SOW redlines.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Deal Desk Manager
Redwood Inference
